mapper.select: SELECT FROM sequence WHERE AND archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY updated_at DESC, id DESC

SELECT FROM sequence WHERE AND id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sequence (workspace_id, name, purpose, owner_id, visibility, status, timezone, weekday_mask, send_window_start, send_window_end, created_by_id, updated_by_id) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{name}, #{purpose}, #{ownerId}, #{visibility}, #{status}, #{timezone}, #{weekdayMask}, #{sendWindowStart}, #{sendWindowEnd}, #{createdById}, #{updatedById})
mapper.update: UPDATE sequence SET name = #{name}, purpose = #{purpose}, visibility = #{visibility}, timezone = #{timezone}, weekday_mask = #{weekdayMask}, send_window_start = #{sendWindowStart}, send_window_end = #{sendWindowEnd}, updated_by_id = #{updatedById} WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND id = #{id} AND archived_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT id, workspace_id, sequence_id, position, step_type, delay_value, delay_unit, advance_policy FROM sequence_step WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND sequence_id = #{sequenceId} ORDER BY position, id

SELECT id, workspace_id, sequence_id, position, step_type, delay_value, delay_unit, advance_policy FROM sequence_step WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND sequence_id = #{sequenceId} ORDER BY position, id FOR SHARE
SELECT workspace_id, step_id, locale, subject, body_text, body_html FROM sequence_step_content WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND step_id IN #{stepId} ORDER BY step_id, locale FOR SHARE
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sequence_step WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND sequence_id = #{sequenceId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO sequence_step (workspace_id, sequence_id, position, step_type, delay_value, delay_unit, advance_policy) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{sequenceId}, #{position}, #{stepType}, #{delayValue}, #{delayUnit}, #{advancePolicy})
INSERT INTO sequence_step_content (workspace_id, step_id, locale, subject, body_text, body_html) VALUES (#{workspaceId}, #{stepId}, #{locale}, #{subject}, #{bodyText}, #{bodyHtml})
mapper.update: UPDATE sequence SET owner_id = NULL WHERE workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND owner_id = #{userId}

UPDATE sequence SET owner_id = CASE WHEN owner_id = #{userId} THEN NULL ELSE owner_id END, created_by_id = CASE WHEN created_by_id = #{userId} THEN NULL ELSE created_by_id END, updated_by_id = CASE WHEN updated_by_id = #{userId} THEN NULL ELSE updated_by_id END WHERE owner_id = #{userId} OR created_by_id = #{userId} OR updated_by_id = #{userId}
